1.note: room order:<id> (channel order:<id>::$chat); Ably rooms have no membership list or metadata: membership = token capability order:* + a server-side member list + presence; orderId/listingId ride in message headers and our server

2.note: messages.send({ text, metadata: { type: 'order_card', card } }); server messages.update(serial, { metadata }) with a Node ChatClient; message.updated event on both sides

3.note: custom before-publish moderation rule (native hook) calling our server, which replies accept with masked text; Hive/Tisane/Bodyguard/Azure are native alternatives. No reporting (pricing: 'coming soon'): our queue

4.note: no email; browser push via the Web Push API with Ably-generated VAPID keys; webhooks for your own notifier

5.note: no translation: our server provider, translations in metadata

6.note: no membership: the agent's token already covers order:* rooms; 'Get help' records the agent server-side; history({ orderBy: OldestFirst }) gives earlier messages (Free plan: 1-day retention vs 30-day Chat default, to verify)

7.note: read receipts are not a Chat SDK feature: lastReadSerial in presence data; typing.keystroke/stop + typing.subscribe (native); no uploads: image inlined as a data URL in metadata for the test (production: object storage + URL)
